subject: Final routing & approver matrix for MSA + Order Form
messages:
From: Laura Ahmed <laura.ahmed@novumhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Novum Health Procurement <procurement@novumhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: MSA + Order Form — signature routing and signer authority

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for moving quickly on the MSA. Attached are our consolidated redlines (Novum_MSA_Redlines_v3.docx). Legal has reviewed and highlighted three non-material edits we flagged in section 9 (data retention), section 12 (subpoena process) and the signature block formatting.

Can you confirm:
- Who will be the Redwood signer (name/title) for the MSA and Order Form?
- Do you have a preferred DocuSign routing order (we generally prefer supplier signs last)?
- Any internal approver matrix we should be aware of on your side so procurement can mirror routing?

We'd like to get this across the finish line this week if possible — our procurement team (cc'd) will initiate the envelope once we confirm routing and signer authority.

Attachments: [Attachment: Novum_MSA_Redlines_v3.docx (docx, 92KB)]

Appreciate it,

Laura Ahmed
Senior Contracts Manager
Novum Health
laura.ahmed@novumhealth.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Laura Ahmed <laura.ahmed@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form — signature routing and signer authority

Laura — thanks for the redlines and the nudge. We can close this week. Below is the plan from Redwood's side:

Approver / Signer matrix (Redwood -> Novum)
- Internal review: Marissa Cole (Legal) to confirm final language and produce the clean MSA (cc'd).
- Redwood execution: Marcus Lin, Head of Revenue Operations — will be the authorized signer for the Order Form and MSA.
- Novum execution: Novum signs first; Redwood signs last (Redwood prefers this routing for our compliance records).

DocuSign routing suggestion:
1) Novum Procurement (Laura Ahmed) — sign Order Form and MSA
2) Novum Legal (if separate) — acknowledge (optional)
3) Redwood Legal (Marissa Cole) — internal review placeholder (does not need signature)
4) Marcus Lin (Head of Revenue Ops) — final signature (Redwood)

If Novum wants Redwood to sign first instead, we can accommodate, but Marcus will need a notification and a short internal approval window (typically <24 hours).

Next steps I will take now:
- Marissa: please confirm any last redline comments and return a final clean MSA + Order Form PDF by EOD.
- Jordan: I will ask you to prepare the envelope and set signer order once Marissa uploads the clean copy.

We will also attach a short exec approval note in the envelope so Finance has the paper trail.

Thanks — I will stand by for the updated clean copy.

Best,

Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form — signature routing and signer authority

Soojin / Jordan — quick legal check. I reviewed Novum_MSA_Redlines_v3 and made one minor clean edit to the execution clause (placement of countersign block) to avoid ambiguity when the DocuSign envelope splits the Order Form and MSA. I attached the updated clean MSA (Redwood_MSA_Clean_v4.docx).

Two requests before we send to DocuSign:
- Please confirm the exact Marcus Lin signing name and title to put in the signature block (we should match his government ID/HR record).
- For audit, add a single-line note in the envelope: "Redwood signs last per agreed routing; copy to Finance Ops". This helps our internal SLA.

Attachment: [Attachment: Redwood_MSA_Clean_v4.docx (docx, 75KB)]

Marissa Cole

Thanks everyone — we have the updated clean copy from Redwood and are ready to proceed. I just initiated the DocuSign envelope (link below) with the following route:

1) Laura Ahmed (Novum Procurement) — review & sign (Order Form + MSA)
2) Chris Patel (Novum Finance) — countersign Order Form (approval)
3) Redwood (Marissa - placeholder review)
4) Marcus Lin (Redwood) — final signature

DocuSign envelope: https://na2.docusign.net/Signing/?env=123456

Attached: OrderForm_CleanCopy.pdf, DocuSign_Envelope_123456.pdf
